{{Quote|Double-bladed lightsaber of Exar Kun, fallen Jedi [&hellip;] Extreme danger&hellip; do not remove from ''nullification resin''&hellip; under&hellip; any&hellip;|Microtag identification of Exar Kun's lightsaber|<ref name="KOTOR 48" />}}
The '''lightsaber''' of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was a device that was initially created to produce a single beam of [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] energy. However, upon his ascension to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Kun redesigned his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] based on instructions hidden within an antiquated [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]. The finished product was a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed weapon]] imbued with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side energy]], from which sapphire blades materialized up to 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from either end of the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]].

Kun wielded the single-bladed version of his lightsaber during his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a student of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], and with it, he earned a reputation as one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] greatest [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duelists]]. The modified, double-bladed saber that heralded his rise as Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was revealed a [[3996 BBY|year later]], when Kun [[Duel in the Senate|confronted]] and [[Death/Legends|slew]] his former Master with it on the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|floor]] of the [[Senate Hall|Galactic Senate Hall]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. With Kun's own [[Wall of light|defeat]] at the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|end]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], his lightsaber was lost on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], only to be rediscovered decades later by an [[Celeste Morne|agent]] of a [[Jedi Covenant|secret covenant of Jedi]] bent on the eradication of all things Sith. Quarantined and preserved for a time in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odryn]], Kun's infamous lightsaber was among the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] pillaged by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty-hunting]] [[Moomo Brothers]], and it changed owners several times before it was eventually returned to the protection of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].

==Description==
===Unique design===
{{Quote|Entry #6305: Progress. I have a lightsaber. The Ithorians stole a nice-looking specimen from the Jedi storehouse, and I have taken it from them. The Jedi are truly a superstitious lot. The weapon is sealed in a special resin and labeled as some kind of evil artifact, dangerous to those using the Force.|Doctor Demagol|<ref name="TSJoDD" />}}
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] original [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] consisted of a metallic [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] that finished in a single [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]] shroud and fastened neatly to clips on his right thigh. The intensity of<ref name="DLOTS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> the [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] beam of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]<ref name="EGWT" /> that it produced was adjustable; at its highest setting, the lightsaber was able to rend [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]], a unique [[Ore/Legends|ore]] highly prized for its lightsaber-resistant qualities.<ref name="DLOTS2" /> Minor modifications were made to include three additional emitter shrouds and a ring at the base to facilitate a belt clip.<ref name="DLOTS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:KunLightsaberSchematic.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A schematic of Kun's redesigned lightsaber]]
In [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">Exar Kun's double-bladed lightsaber debuted during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 3]], and [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] identifies [[3996 BBY]] as the year that Kun entered the Great Sith War.</ref> Kun's lightsaber underwent extensive alterations, the most significant of them being the incorporation of a second emitter assembly that was identical to the one already installed. A single [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] activated both ends of the newly-created saberstaff&mdash;together or independent of one another&mdash;which was recharged by a hidden socket situated just below the ubiquitous black handgrip. Dual focusing cores complete with [[Focusing lens/Legends|lens crystal assemblies]] were crossed by a pair of power conduits that wired into a single red [[activation stud]] at either end of the hilt.<ref name="EGWT" /> Three smaller, colored, and vertically-aligned buttons<ref name="JvS" /> were on the black surface of the protruding emitter assemblies, which were protected by four symmetrically-placed, pronged emitter shrouds. Included were paneled controls that adjusted the blade length between 0.5 and 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], as well as diagnostic systems. Opposite the octagonal [[Dual-phase lightsaber/Legends|dual-phase]] control was an identically-shaped mechanism that adjusted the intensity of the lightsaber's twin blades, which, at their lowest setting, served little more purpose than a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], neither able to inflict damage nor resist opposing weapons in combat. At full power, the lightsaber resisted the blades of others and cleaved through virtually anything else with which it came into contact,<ref name="EGWT" /> including weapons [[Force weapon|empowered]] by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DLOTS1" /><ref name="TSW3" />

===Advantages===
{{Quote|Time to make this more interesting. Do you like the modifications I made to my lightsaber, Master?|Exar Kun reveals the second blade of his lightsaber|<ref name="TSW3" />}}
Extendable belt clips jutted from the base of each emitter shroud and allowed the lightsaber's handler to conveniently affix the device to their person from either end.<ref name="EGWT" /> Following his embrace of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Kun's weapon was infused with the negative energies of its creator,<ref name="KOTOR 48" /> and those who faced him were unsettled by its insidious nature.<ref name="EGWT" /> Inheritors of the weapon who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to the Force found themselves infected with the lightsaber's residual malevolent power, while those with no such affinity remained unaffected.<ref name="KOTOR 48" />

The efficiency of Kun's preferred [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat style]] of [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI: Niman]]<ref name="KOTORCG" /> was further complemented by his saberstaff's improvements. In an era when such weapons were all but forgotten,<ref name="JvS" /> the double-bladed nature of Kun's lightsaber bewildered enemy combatants. A single ignited end often preceded the opposite and served to offset the opposition when finally activated in the heat of battle.<ref name="TSW3" /> Offensive attacks were blocked by one blade as the hand grip was quickly spun to deliver a [[Death/Legends|killing]] blow with the other. Swift adjustments of either blade's length or intensity caused enemies to overextend themselves and allowed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] to counterattack with lethality.<ref name="EGWT" /> Combined with his incredible mastery of the Force, Kun was a nearly unbeatable warrior when also armed with his double-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
===Exar Kun's weapon===
{{Quote|By the Force! I thought a lightsaber could cut through anything. The walls are barely scratched. The only thing that can resist a lightsaber is&hellip;Mandalorian iron!|Exar Kun, regarding Freedon Nadd's tomb|audio=NaddsTombMandoIron-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="DLOTSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:KunOnYavin.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Exar Kun, with his lightsaber clipped to his belt]]
As a Jedi trainee, Exar Kun created a single, blue-bladed lightsaber during his years of [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under the legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], a [[Krevaaki]] [[Lore Keeper|Jedi scholar]] and reputed [[Jedi artisan/Legends|connoisseur]] of lightsaber construction. With his original saber, Kun surpassed fellow apprentices [[Crado]] and [[Sylvar]]; he also faced Baas with his own weapon and that of Crado's, a practice bout that resulted in Baas' defeat and the [[Sun djem/Legends|splintering]] of his Force-imbued [[Master Vodo's quarterstaff|quarterstaff]].<ref name="DLOTS1" /> Later, while he defiantly pursued knowledge deemed forbidden by his Master, Exar Kun ventured to the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd|tomb]] of a long-dead [[Sith sorcerer]] and tested his weapon against the strength of its walls, specially wrought of lightsaber-resistant [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]]. Initially unsuccessful, the blade's highest intensity was ultimately required to penetrate the unyielding structure. Kun's lightsaber was also the bane of two [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cultists]] who tried to waylay the errant Jedi upon his return from the tomb, to their cost.<ref name="DLOTS2" />

As he grew stronger in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore and power and became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], Kun was relieved of his lightsaber on several occasions by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Freedon Nadd]]&mdash;the same Sith sorcerer whose tomb Kun had desecrated with difficulty&mdash;only to have it returned when he completely surrendered himself to the dark side.<ref name="DLOTSA" /> The lightsaber itself became infused with dark side energy<ref name="KOTOR 48" /> as Kun relied more on Sith power. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], he was no longer able to sustain himself or utilize his weapon through any other means, having forsaken the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]].<ref name="DLOTS3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> As he sought to consolidate his power in a bid for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] Sith supremacy, Kun, who by then had begun to consider himself the greatest living swordsman in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="DLOTSA" /> wielded his weapon against another Jedi of similarly recognized skill, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], in a [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|duel]] that ultimately ended without decision, as both chose instead to join forces as [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and wage the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DLOTS6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref>

[[File:Exar_Kun_Lightsaber_Timeline.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Exar Kun with his double-bladed lightsaber]]
As the newly-christened Dark Lord of the Sith, Kun continued to use his single and blue-bladed lightsaber&mdash;despite a traditional Sith preference for bloodshine blades<ref name="JvS" />&mdash;sometimes alongside another of similar design, left to swing freely from his belt when not in service.<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref> He increased his own dark side knowledge through study of a variety of resources, including an ancient [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] with instructions for the creation of an especially exotic lightsaber: one that produced a blade from either end of the hilt.<ref name="JvS" /> The improved lightsaber was soon afterward wielded in combat against Kun's former Master, Vodo-Siosk Baas, who was slain in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Grand Chamber]] of the Galactic Republic [[Senate Hall]] upon revelation of the double-bladed nature of the Dark Lord's weapon.<ref name="TSW3" /> When the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|attacked]] the Jedi [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], Kun's lightsaber saw further action in a duel with the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library's]] aged [[Keeper of Antiquities]], [[Ood Bnar]].<ref name="TSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref> Kun was forced to [[Essence transfer|abandon]] his body at the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|end]] of the war,<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> and for a time, his lightsaber was thought lost in the conflagration.<ref name="KOTOR 48" />

===Recovery and later usage===
{{Quote|And you will have ''this''. Something I ''picked up'' to match your fighting style. Something from a ''great warrior''&hellip;|Demagol bestows upon Jarael the lightsaber of Exar Kun|<ref name="KOTOR 48" />}}
Several decades after the demise of Exar Kun, the recovery of his lightsaber became an issue of great importance for the [[Jedi Covenant]], a secret subsect of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dedicated to preventing the spread of Sith influence of any kind. After its discovery by Covenant [[Jedi Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]], Kun's lightsaber was quarantined on the planet [[Odryn]] in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]], a storehouse of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] considered extremely dangerous by the Order. The weapon was encased in protective [[nullification resin]] to stifle its residual dark side influence, complete with a [[Covenant identichip]] that warned of the danger posed by removal from said protection.<ref name="KOTOR 48" /> In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] siblings known as the [[Moomo Brothers]] infiltrated the Sanctum of the Exalted and stole a number of Sith artifacts, including Kun's lightsaber.<ref name="TSJoDD" />

[[File:JaraelSaber.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Exar Kun's lightsaber, in the hands of Jarael]]
The Dark Lord's weapon was taken from the Moomo Brothers soon afterward by the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]], who successfully removed it from containment for examination and immediately noticed an amplification of his own persuasive Force abilities.<ref name="TSJoDD" /> He in turn gave it to a former student of his, an [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] named [[Jarael]], to complement her particular fighting style. Although she was not sensitive to the Force, Jarael handled the lightsaber with deadly accuracy.<ref name="KOTOR 49">[[Knights of the Old Republic 49|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 49]]</ref> With it she attacked Demagol's daughter, her longtime enemy [[Chantique]],<ref name="KOTOR 48" /> who ultimately acquired it and experienced an immediate surge in her ability to manipulate the Force. Also armed with the confiscated [[Zayne Carrick's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of former Jedi [[Zayne Carrick]], Chantique attempted to avenge herself against Demagol with the two weapons, only to be stabbed in the back by her father and have them taken away. When he later dropped them in anger, he tried to take up Carrick's lightsaber to defend himself from Chantique, but due to his untrained Force powers combined with Carrick's Force balancing ability he had selected Kun's double bladed lightsaber instead. When he turned it on, both blades ignited and fatally [[Shiak|impaled]] both himself and his daughter with the saberstaff. With their deaths, Kun's double-bladed lightsaber and his [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] were returned by Carrick to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] for safekeeping.<ref name="KOTOR 50" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|A saber-staff! The weapon of Exar Kun! Did he construct that?''"<br />"''The prototype was two lightsabers he had welded pommel-to-pommel in imitation of the Iridonian zhaboka. I furnished the knowledge that allowed him to improve on the original design and construct the one he is using.''"<br />"''It strikes me as unnecessary, but I won't deny his mastery of the Jar'Kai technique. Niman and teräs käsi will never substitute for dun möch, but I appreciate that you have trained him to be a fighting machine rather than a true apprentice.|Darth Plagueis and Darth Sidious, discussing Maul's lightsaber design|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
Exar Kun's double-bladed lightsaber reintroduced the unique weapon as a design option to duelists in the galaxy at large. While recognized as a development of the ancient Sith,<ref name="JvS" /> double-bladed lightsabers became prevalent among Jedi in subsequent years and saw widespread use during the [[Jedi Civil War]] by Jedi such as [[Bastila Shan]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> and during the [[First Jedi Purge]] by Jedi such as [[Zez-Kai Ell]]<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> despite its deliberately offensive design.<ref name="JvS" /> The double-bladed lightsaber also remained very popular among the factions of Sith that succeeded Kun's Brotherhood. As the first in a considerable period of time to use one in combat, Kun was erroneously credited with the saberstaff's design conception, an impression that was corrected in a [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force|historical compilation]] prepared by Jedi historian [[Tionne Solusar]], from information found in the [[Tedryn Holocron]].<ref name="JvS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|However, it would be the double-bladed lightsaber Gossett envisioned for dark Jedi Exar Kun that would capture fans' imaginations. Though Kun did not use it until ''The Sith War'', which was drawn by Dario Carrasco, it was Gossett who conceived of this ideal Sith weapon. Such a unique design caused nervousness at Lucasfilm, as it truly pushed what was seen in the films. But after some creative back-and-forth with Dark Horse editor Dan Thorsland, they approved Gossett's design. Five years later Gossett was overjoyed to see Darth Maul wield the dual blades in ''The Phantom Menace''.|Michael Kogge|<ref name="Legendary Authors">{{InsiderCite|153|Authors of the Expanded Universe|Authors of the Expanded Universe: ''Tales'' of the ''Sith''}}</ref>}}
[[File:KunActionFigure.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Exar Kun's double-bladed lightsaber-equipped Hasbro action figure]]
One of many original concepts created by [[Tom Veitch]]<ref name="ITV">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Tom Veitch|Interview with Tom Veitch]]</ref> and visual depictions rendered by [[Chris Gossett]] for the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="ICG">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Christian Gossett|Interview with Christian Gossett]]</ref> Exar Kun's lightsaber initially appeared in its single-bladed form alongside its owner in the first four issues of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']], and it was penciled by Gossett without any intricate detail. The lightsaber appeared in the final issue of the series, [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Jedi Assault'']], wherein [[Art Wetherell]] drew all depicted lightsabers with a similar appearance to one another. [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]] was the artist for [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War|''The Sith War'']], the next ''Tales of a Jedi'' comic series in which Kun appeared with his lightsaber, which was shown worn unconventionally from his belt. The device maintained its single-bladed exclusivity for the first two issues of the story arc, but the saberstaff variant was revealed in the third, titled [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''The Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma'']]. The lightsaber's final ''Tales of the Jedi'' appearance was in the fifth issue of ''The Sith War'', [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Brother Against Brother'']].

Exar Kun's lightsaber became a major plot device in the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon]]'' story arc, in which it is finally transferred to the wardship of the Jedi Order. It appeared in the [[Timeline 9: The Mandalorian Wars|ninth]] and [[Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|tenth]] [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] accounts made by Jedi Archivist [[Gnost-Dural]], a character from [[BioWare]]'s [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and was briefly mentioned in the novel ''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]'' by [[Michael Reaves]]. An action figure of Kun, complete with a removable double-bladed lightsaber, is included in ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'', made by [[Hasbro]]. A mini-statue of a double-bladed lightsaber-equipped Kun is also numbered among those of the [[Champions of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Champions of the Force'']] set of ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]''.

A fully detailed schematic was provided for Kun's double-bladed lightsaber in ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', and clarification of Kun's inspiration for its creation was given in [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]. While brief mentions were made in ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'', ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]'', the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', [[The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|''The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol'']], a short story made available to [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] members, gives an account of the device while in possession of Demagol of the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series. Kun's [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry identifies his lightsaber as the first double-blade in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe, preceding the appearance of Sith Lord [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] saberstaff by several out-of-universe years.
